title: Transport, Protocol, Capability & Security Contract Closure
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-25 owner direction: fully map and preserve project work/dependencies before PCV implementation; split interstitials as needed.
objective: Freeze the safe zero-service transport/handshake contract before code: inference-safe signaling, peer binding, versioned/bounded envelopes, policy/timeouts, exact capability/entitlement negotiation and replaceable assisted networking.
acceptance: Define pre-auth and post-auth signaling fields, recipient binding and no-log sensitive token handling.
Define peer-to-authenticated-subject/device binding and transport revalidation without granting authority to SDP/device metadata.
Define explicit protocol/schema versioning, strict decoder behavior, message/batch/work bounds, backpressure and safe errors.
Resolve exact pack/rules/runtime/entitlement handshake sources from locally measured client state.
Keep manual/no-service ICE as baseline and assisted STUN/TURN/relay as replaceable optional adapters.
Record governed invitation/connection timeout policy and future Android local-network permission trigger.
boundaries: No Multiversal-app PCV runtime implementation is authorized.
PCV-I01A through PCV-I02 remain completed predecessor contracts and are not reopened.
PCV-I04+ and PCV-03 children remain predecessor-blocked.
next_action: Validate the exact AIOC PCV-I03 transport/protocol/capability/security closure candidate. Do not modify Multiversal-app runtime, activate external networking services, change Android permissions or begin PCV-I04.

last_material_progress.evidence: governance/application-planning/product-convergence/PCV-I03_TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_SECURITY_CONTRACT_v1.0.0.json closes the 15 PCV-I03 primary findings at contract level while preserving runtime realization for PCV-03C and recovery/event semantics for PCV-I04.
